title: Stream schedule
intro: The next {days} days, {tz} time. This is only a short-term overview — the schedule can always change.
imageEmptyHint: Come back soon for the next stream!
coversNoKey: No Rawg access code: games are shown without a cover. Enter it in [Game covers]({link}).
coversDenied: Rawg refuses the access code: games are shown without a cover. Check it in the “Game covers” module.
coversDown: RAWG cannot be reached right now: games are shown without a cover, and the search will be tried again.
coversNone: RAWG does not know: {games}. Check the spelling in the event description (the “Jeu: …” line).
coversAmbiguous: For these games, the cover may belong to another game:
noStreamHint: Check back soon, the schedule changes often.
apIntro: This is what each look gives with sample streams. Pick yours just below, in the “Schedule look” setting, then save.
apd_original: The original look: one heading per day, then the streams as a list.
apd_classic: A sober agenda: time on the left, title and game, cover on the right.
apd_alternating: The day name swaps from left to right from one day to the next.
apd_week: Seven columns, Monday to Sunday: the whole week at a glance.
apd_timeline: A vertical thread with dated dots, airy, with small covers.
apd_posters: Tall poster-style cards, big cover with the title on top.
apd_hero: The next stream big, with “In X h”, then the rest as a compact list.
adminNoSlots: No upcoming stream for now. The schedule shows the streams of your calendars: install and set up “Online calendar” (Google Calendar…) or “Hand-written streams” in [Extensions](/admin/extensions). Already done? Then nothing is planned.
coversNoKeyNoModule: No Rawg access code: games are shown without a cover. A free module, “Game covers”, takes care of it.
coversSuggestReason: finds the cover pictures of your games
adminWithHidden: in your contacts, but not shown (card to check or “Do not show”)
adminWithUnknown: not in your contacts, so not shown.
adminWithWait: Contacts did not answer, not shown for now
adminWithAddHelp: In Contacts, choose “Add via” Twitch and paste the name: it then appears on the schedule.
adminWithNoBook: Names appear on the schedule once Contacts is installed. Until then, these names are not shown.
adminWithSuggest: shows the name of the people you stream with
adminWithBusy: Contacts is not answering right now: names will come back as soon as it does.
adminPhotoWhy_unreachable: the photo site did not answer
adminPhotoWhy_refused: the photo site refused the request
adminPhotoWhy_notImage: the file is not a usable image
adminPhotoWhy_tooBig: the image is too big (256 KB at most)
adminPhotoWhy_save: the site could not keep the copy
adminPhotoNone_address: This photo cannot be copied here
adminPhotoRetryOff: Partner photos are turned off in the settings.
adminPlayedOk: Game suggestions is installed. Each game of a started stream joins “Already played”, once. A game already there stays as it is.
adminPlayedNone: Game suggestions is not installed: no game is added for now.
adminPlayedSuggest: keeps the list of the games you have played
adminPlayedBusy: Game suggestions does not answer right now: games will be added as soon as it does.
